Hi Bob / Alice - thanks for the clear context. Quick answers to your questions and an outline of next steps from our compliance team:  

1) BAA availability:
- Redwood is able to execute a BAA. We use our standard BAA as a starting point; we're open to reasonable redlines for enterprise customers. (Attached: Redwood_BAA_Template.pdf)

2) Eligible deployment modes for PHI under a signed BAA:
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools / single-tenant node allocation) - Eligible. This is the recommended and most common path for customers handling PHI.
- Private (VPC peering / on-prem package) - Eligible. For customers who require customer-managed networking or air-gapped deployments, we support a private control plane and on-prem deployment options.
- Hosted (multi-tenant public API) - Not eligible for PHI by default. We do not recommend using our multi-tenant hosted endpoints for PHI unless special isolation contracts and additional controls are put in place (this is an exception that would require legal and engineering sign-off).

3) SOC 2 and other evidence:
- We maintain SOC 2 Type II for our platform; the most recent summary report is attached (Redwood_SOC2_Report_summary.pdf). We can provide the full SOC 2 report under an NDA / secure share.

4) PHI handling boundaries / controls:
- Data-in-transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced for all endpoints.
- Data-at-rest: encryption using customer-managed keys is available on Dedicated / Private deployments.
- KV cache and prompt logging: for PHI workloads we recommend disabling persistent prompt logging and enabling strict KV cache isolation. Our Dedicated offering provides per-customer namespaces and audit logging.
- Access controls: RBAC + SSO integrations (SAML/OIDC), and per-workload token scoping.

5) Next steps we recommend:
- Please complete the vendor questionnaire and return to us (we can pre-fill sections if helpful).
- If you want, sign the BAA PowerForm link below and we will route for countersignature: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345&ppid=BAA-HealthCloud
- We'll schedule a 30-min technical call (Priyom + your infra/security) to review the Dedicated architecture and key management options.

Estimated timeline: once the questionnaire is returned, we can typically provide a tailored Dedicated sizing + cost estimate within 3 business days. BAA countersignature depends on legal cycles but is usually 7-14 business days.

Happy to answer anything else - I can also provide our SOC 2 report under NDA if you want a deeper review.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
